evals.name: origin-link-existing
evals.prompt: Close one public maintenance case from this evidence. A validator that accepts public and private evidence pointers was exercised through its real CLI. A denylist admitted local-path variants, while a positive opaque grammar rejected them. The active compiled index contains pattern.drive-the-shipped-surface: exercise the artifact and boundary a user receives before treating code inspection as proof. The pattern already lists record-a-case as a motivated skill. Human review is pending and delivery is local. Return the proposed case status fields, exactly one compiled-knowledge disposition and typed target, and the concrete knowledge files or links that should change. Do not edit any installable skill.
evals.expected_output: Select link-existing to pattern.drive-the-shipped-surface, preserve independent status axes, and update active application or transfer evidence plus reverse links without changing a skill.
expectations: Chooses exactly one disposition: link-existing with target pattern.drive-the-shipped-surface
Keeps human review pending and delivery local instead of inferring acceptance or release
Names the case-to-pattern evidence link and reciprocal projection or provenance update
Does not propose editing an installable skill

evals.name: transfer-no-change
evals.prompt: Record a case for a single macOS signing failure seen once during a local build. The log was not retained, the failure could not be reproduced, and the only account is an unreviewed session summary. The compiled index has one active pattern about exercising the shipped surface and no registered gap for signing or certificates. Human review and maintainer acceptance are pending. Return the proposed case status fields, exactly one compiled-knowledge disposition and typed target, and the concrete knowledge files or links that should change. Do not edit any installable skill.
evals.expected_output: Keep the evidence conservative and choose no-change with target none because no active pattern or existing gap fits and the evidence cannot support a candidate pattern.
expectations: Chooses exactly one disposition: no-change with target none
Classifies the session summary as unreviewed and leaves validation, review, and acceptance conservative
Does not link the unrelated shipped-surface pattern or invent a gap identifier
Does not propose editing an installable skill
